name: Fuma Chunin

entries.name: Lethal Precision
entries.text: Critical hits made with ranged weapon attacks add +2 damage dice to the result.

entries.name: Lethal Hunter
entries.text: Ranged weapon attacks gain a +1 bonus to damage die (already added), and increase damage dealt with ranged taijutsu attacks using that weapon by 1 die.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Fuma Chunin may make two attacks with its currently equipped weapons.

entries.name: Kunai
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Shuriken
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Fuma Shuriken
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

notes: Falling Heaven: Storm is printed "Falling Heaven: Falling Heaven: Storm".
